propositions: Before any axis can become config-driven, a provider-neutral foundation is needed: config schema, layered overlay/merge, fail-closed validation, and capability descriptor declaring which axes a target has.
The mapping block must be parsed as a reserved config section [tool.rebar.mapping] (added to _RESERVED_SECTIONS), not coerced into JiraConfig, and read raw via read_reserved_section.

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) deep-merge per key with precedence built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>, while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) replace wholesale with most-specific winning.
Validation must fail closed offline with MappingConfigError when axis-map values fall outside declared vocabulary, blocks are malformed, or a capability-absent axis is referenced.
The module must be provider-neutral, importing no adapters.jira* code and containing no Jira value literals, with the adapter injecting built-in defaults and capability values.
A Capability descriptor dataclass declares which mapping axes the target has (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities), gating axis maps and transition replay.
